Hi, we are currently hiring for the role of GenAI Engineer.

Here is a quick snapshot of the opportunity:

- Experience: 3-6 years

- Skills: GenAI Engineer

- Location: Bangalore, India

- Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and implement generative AI models to create innovative solutions for complex problems.

- Collaborate with cross functional teams to integrate AI technologies into existing systems and processes.

- Analyze and optimize AI algorithms to improve efficiency and performance.

- Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning technologies to ensure best practices.

- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members.




Apply Here https://theglove.ezrecruit.ai/apply/PX1W_wFWGe2r
